description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.
